name: Ember
description: A 2D platformer where you play the Pyros logo. Your flame is your health, your light and your clock at once: it burns down on its own, ember shards feed it, frostlings eat it, and the mid-air flare jump spends it. The level, the lights, the emitters and the HUD are all authored in PyrosBuilder; the scene script only runs the game. Shows 2D lighting with occluder shadows, parallax layers, spritesheet animation, Box2D platforming with moving platforms, particles and a synthesised soundtrack.
author: Duarte Peixinho
